page_title: PSG 4-1 MON | PSG v Monaco 07/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 4 - 1 Goal! Nuno Mendes provides Ousmane Dembele (PSG) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 4:1.
87' Lucas Michal (Monaco) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.

85' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma!
84' Substitution. Breel Embolo will be replaced by Lucas Michal (Monaco).
84' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
83' A mid-range free kick is awarded to PSG out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
82' Kang-In Lee (PSG) and Vitinha perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
80' Marquinhos (PSG) is able to continue to play.
78' Marquinhos (PSG) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
78' A first-time shot by Denis Zakaria (Monaco) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
76' Adi Hutter has decided to make a change. Krepin Diatta (Monaco) replaces Caio Henrique.
74' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Ousmane Dembele (PSG) causes Radoslaw Majecki little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
73' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post.
70' Nuno Mendes (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
69' Caio Henrique (Monaco) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Gianluigi Donnarumma comes off his line to intercept.
68' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
67' Here is a change. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
67' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
65' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) sends a long ball in, but Gianluigi Donnarumma comfortably gathers the ball.
64' The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Bradley Barcola.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kang-In Lee (PSG) comes onto the pitch so that Desire Doue can be given a rest.
63' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Takumi Minamino is replaced by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco).
63' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Mika Biereth and he is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
62' The substitution is prepared. Al Musrati (Monaco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Soungoutou Magassa.
61' Desire Doue (PSG) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
61' A clumsy foul by Willian Pacho (PSG) and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.
59' The current number of shots on goal is 5:2.
57' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Desire Doue tees up Ousmane Dembele (PSG) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top right corner and past Radoslaw Majecki.
56' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Radoslaw Majecki is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.

54' 2 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Bradley Barcola picks out an unmarked Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the roof of the net. 2:1.
50' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
48' PENALTY APPEAL after Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Golden opportunity! Desire Doue (PSG) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Nuno Mendes (PSG) tries to find Ousmane Dembele, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
41' The ball possession is 77:23.
40' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
38' CLOSE! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
37' Nuno Mendes (PSG) smashes the ball upfield and Bradley Barcola brings it down with a fine first touch.
36' Bradley Barcola (PSG) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
34' Desire Doue (PSG) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
30' The goal by Bradley Barcola (PSG) is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to the ball going out of play.
28' Desire Doue (PSG) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
28' Bradley Barcola (PSG) scores a goal, but Clement Turpin makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand.
26' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
23' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
22' What a poor attempt! Vitinha (PSG) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
21' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

17' 1 - 1 Soungoutou Magassa passes the ball into the penalty area. Denis Zakaria (Monaco) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom right corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:1!
16' Joao Neves (PSG) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
15' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) and Ousmane Dembele matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
10' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
6' 1 - 0 Vitinha (PSG) proves that he is an excellent free-kick taker after finding the back of the net with a clever shot that goes straight into the bottom right corner!
6' It seemed like Vitinha (PSG) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
5' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert and denies him.
4' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will supervise the game today.
